page_title: MEX 2-3 ENG | Mexico v England 06/07/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Alireza Faghani is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+13' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) whips in a cross from the corner, but Jordan Pickford is well positioned and punches the ball away.
90+12' Raul Jimenez (Mexico) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball is out of play. Mexico win a corner kick.
90+12' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
90+10' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Roberto Alvarado (Mexico). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90+8' Although Jordan Henderson (England) is just on the bench, Alireza Faghani has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+8' A yellow card for bad language! Johan Vasquez (Mexico) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
90+7' Raul Jimenez (Mexico) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
90+7' Edson Alvarez (Mexico) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
90+6' Raul Jimenez (Mexico) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
90+4' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
90+4' Jude Bellingham (England) takes a long-range shot, but his attempt is not a big threat to the goalkeeper.

90+3' Brian Gutierrez (Mexico) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and England will have a goal kick.
90+2' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Brian Gutierrez (Mexico) took the corner.
90+2' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Mexico have been awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 11 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Morgan Rogers (England) is coming onto the pitch as Harry Kane cannot continue after picking up an injury.
89' A long pass finds Alvaro Fidalgo (Mexico), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford reacts well to make a good save.
88' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
87' The linesman signals that Raul Jimenez (Mexico) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
86' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) serves up a nice cross, but Jordan Pickford punches the ball away.
85' Declan Rice (England) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
84' Foul! Raul Jimenez (Mexico) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. A free kick to England.
84' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
83' Santiago Gimenez (Mexico) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
81' Substitution. Julian Quinones walks off the pitch and Guillermo Martinez Ayala (Mexico) comes on as a substitute.
80' Edson Alvarez (Mexico) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post.
80' Corner kick. Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) is ready to send the ball into the box.
80' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Mexico.
80' Mexico take a short corner kick.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Alvaro Fidalgo (Mexico) coming on for Jorge Sanchez.
79' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
78' An attempted cross from Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) is cleared. Mexico have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Brian Gutierrez (Mexico) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
76' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Roberto Alvarado (Mexico), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
75' Substitution. Elliot Anderson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dan Burn (England).
74' Thomas Tuchel has decided to make a change. Djed Spence (England) replaces Nico O'Reilly.
73' The referee blows for a cooling break.
72' The referee gives a yellow card to Nico O'Reilly (England).
71' Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
69' 2 - 3 Goal! Raul Jimenez (Mexico) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Jordan Pickford.
69' Raul Jimenez (Mexico) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
68' Marc Guehi (England) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
68' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Mexico!
67' Referee Alireza Faghani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Mexico. Let’s see what happens!
66' Brian Gutierrez (Mexico) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
65' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
65' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now Mexico have a corner.
63' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
61' Javier Aguirre has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Brian Gutierrez (Mexico) replacing Luis Romo.
61' Santiago Gimenez (Mexico) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gilberto Mora.
60' 1 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Harry Kane (England) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Raul Rangel no chance!
59' Harry Kane (England) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
58' Raul Rangel (Mexico) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. A penalty is awarded to England!
57' Here comes a substitution. Bukayo Saka is given a rest as he is replaced by John Stones (England).
57' My Gran could have done better! Julian Quinones (Mexico) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
54' He’s off! Jarell Quansah (England) gets his marching orders from referee Alireza Faghani after the VAR review.

53' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Jarell Quansah (England) using VAR. This could result in a red card!

52' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jorge Sanchez (Mexico). Alireza Faghani saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. England win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
51' Jude Bellingham (England) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' Nico O'Reilly (England) blows a good opportunity to score. Without any hesitation he fires in a shot from mid range, but the ball crashes against the right post!
49' Nico O'Reilly (England) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
48' Julian Quinones (Mexico) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
46' Javier Aguirre makes a half-time substitution. Edson Alvarez (Mexico) comes on in place of Cesar Montes.
46' Alireza Faghani blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
45+4' The resulting corner from Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) is cleared.
45+3' Raul Jimenez (Mexico) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the top left corner, but Jordan Pickford is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
45+1' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Raul Jimenez (Mexico), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
42' 1 - 2 Goal! Julian Quinones (Mexico) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
42' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
42' Bukayo Saka (England) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Alireza Faghani blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Mexico.
41' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
41' Bukayo Saka (England) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Mexico, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

38' 0 - 2 Goal! Harry Kane displays great vision and sends a pass to Jude Bellingham (England), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 0:2.
36' 0 - 1 Bukayo Saka showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Jude Bellingham (England) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 0:1.
36' Jordan Pickford displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Raul Jimenez (Mexico) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

34' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Mexico are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
32' Luis Romo (Mexico) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
28' Gilberto Mora (Mexico) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for England.

26' Anthony Gordon (England) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Raul Rangel thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
23' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
21' Declan Rice (England) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
21' Anthony Gordon (England) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. England have a corner.
19' Gilberto Mora (Mexico) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
18' Alireza Faghani couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) and blew his whistle.
16' The corner from Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) is intercepted by the defence.

16' Roberto Alvarado (Mexico) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Mexico are going to take it.
15' What a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Jordan Pickford dived superbly to deny Raul Jimenez (Mexico), whose header was directed to the bottom right corner.
14' Marc Guehi (England) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
12' Luis Romo (Mexico) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
9' A cross by Bukayo Saka (England) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
9' Declan Rice (England) takes the corner with a short pass.
8' Anthony Gordon (England) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and England have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
3' Raul Jimenez (Mexico) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
1' Declan Rice (England) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alireza Faghani had an easy-decision to make.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and England will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to bad weather.
